Design Mode

Overview

The Design Mode in the RADD Code Generator plugin is a feature aimed at helping designers identify, fix, and manage issues in their designs to ensure they are aligned with create product-specific Components guideline. While it doesn't guarantee a fully compliant design, it serves as a support tool to enhance the quality of the designs and help avoid major issues that could affect the handoff to development.

The Design Mode checks a subset of rules from the Create product-specific Components guideline. Due to certain limitations, not all rules can be checked programmatically, and some are yet to be implemented. Future updates will expand the ruleset to cover more areas of design compliance.

Purpose of design mode

Improve design quality: It helps designers to ensure their designs are closer to being RADD-compliant, with high-quality design according to design best practices and ready for development.
Provide guidance: When issues are found, the mode provides recommendations or fixes that the designer can implement.
Ensure a smooth handoff: By addressing issues in design mode, the team can reduce potential problems during the handoff process to developers.
While Design Mode doesn't currently cover all aspects of compliance, it serves as a valuable resource for refining and improving design workflows.

Types of issues in design mode

Design Mode flags two main types of issues:

1. Errors:
Definition: These are critical issues that must be resolved before the design can be considered RADD-compliant.
The design is not RADD compliant and the generated code will not function as expected. Errors must be fixed to proceed.
2. Warnings/Suggestions:
Definition: Warnings highlight areas where the design could be improved for better compliance or performance leading to better code generation.
Impact: Warnings don't block the handoff process. The generated code will still work even if warnings are present. It’s up to the team to review and decide whether to address them. If a warning is deemed unnecessary, it can simply be ignored.
Ignored Issues: Once a warning has been reviewed, designers can choose to ignore it. All ignored warnings will be listed under an "Ignored" issues tab, allowing the team to revisit them later if needed.
Why not all rules are checked in design mode

Programmatic limitations: Some design rules are subjective or too complex to be automatically checked by a tool.
Ongoing development: As the plugin evolves, more rules will be included to ensure broader coverage.
List of Checked Rules

Explanation of labels:
savings  INHERITED
 - If a component/component set is used as a component instance it will inherit the issue from the main component

warning  NOT INHERITED
 - A component instance will not inherit the issue from the main component.

Common Rules

Naming Rules

ERROR → Layer names can only have latin characters.
Rule: NAME_HAS_LATIN_CHARACTERS
savings  INHERITED

ERROR → Layer names must never start with a number.
Rule: NAME_STARTS_WITH_LETTER
savings  INHERITED

ERROR → Element names cannot be over 50 characters.
Rule: HAS_PROPER_LENGTH_NAME
savings  INHERITED

Styling Rules

ERROR → Token, Property value and Style names must never start with a number.
Rule: STYLE_TOKEN_NAME_STARTS_WITH_LETTER
warning  NOT INHERITED

ERROR → Layer names must never start with a number.
Rule: NAME_STARTS_WITH_LETTER
warning  NOT INHERITED

ERROR → Element names cannot be over 50 characters.
Rule: HAS_PROPER_LENGTH_NAME
warning  NOT INHERITED

Shapes

ERROR → Element names cannot be over 50 characters.
Rule: HAS_PROPER_LENGTH_NAME
warning  NOT INHERITED

Frames

ERROR → Frames must have auto-layout.
Rule: HAS_AUTO_LAYOUT
warning  NOT INHERITED

ERROR → Component layers cannot have position sticky AND position absolute at the same time.
Rule: HAS_NO_CONFLICTING_POSITIONS
warning  NOT INHERITED

ERROR → If using the 'List container' suffix on the frame name, check your layer panel and make sure you are using a repeating element or set of elements inside it.
Rule: HAS_LIST_CONTAINER_WITH_NO_PATTERN
warning  NOT INHERITED

ERROR → Repeating elements, or set of elements in your layer panel must be inside a parent frame using the suffix ‘List container’.
Rule: USE_LIST_CONTAINER_IF_THERE_IS_PATTERN
warning  NOT INHERITED

ERROR → Frame and Text layer names must all be semantic.
Rule: HAS_NON_DEFAULT_NODE_NAME
warning  NOT INHERITED

ERROR(Mobile Design) → Strokes and borders must always be set on the 'inside' and 'included’.
Rule: HAS_INSIDE_STROKE_ALIGN_AND_STROKES_INCLUDED
warning  NOT INHERITED

Components

ERROR → Component names must all be in ‘Title Case’, e.g. 'ODS Bottom Sheet'.
Rule: WORDS_START_WITH_CAPITAL
warning  NOT INHERITED

ERROR → Interactive component state properties may include no more than: 'Standard', 'Hovered', 'Pressed', 'Focused', 'Visited’. Any other 'State' needs should be added as booleans.
Rule: STATE_PROPERTY_SHOULD_HAVE_SPECIFIC_SET_OF_VALUES
warning  NOT INHERITED

ERROR → Property names must never start with a number.
Rule: PROPERTY_NAME_STARTS_WITH_LETTER
warning  NOT INHERITED

WARNING → Component set names should start with the acronym set in the plugin settings. e.g. 'ODS Link', ‘MMKC Button’.
Rule: USE_STARTS_WITH_CORRECT_DS_PREFIXLIST_CONTAINER_IF_THERE_IS_PATTERN
warning  NOT INHERITED

Instances

ERROR → Multiple instances of the same component, used inside another component, cannot have the same name, they must have semantic names to differentiate them.
Rule: HAS_SEMANTIC_NAME
warning  NOT INHERITED

ERROR → Component instances can only have Frame Dimension overrides: Width, Height, Min/Max dimensions, Horizontal/Vertical resizing (Fill, Hug, Fix).
Rule: HAS_ALLOWED_STYLING_CHANGES
warning  NOT INHERITED

Text

ERROR → Frame and Text layer names must all be semantic.
Rule: HAS_NON_DEFAULT_NODE_NAME
warning  NOT INHERITED
